opportunities.title: Luxury Home Interior Visualization Design
opportunities.description: We are seeking an experienced and creative interior designer / architectural visualization specialist to assist with the interior design of a luxury custom-built home in Ontario, Canada. Our home is approximately 6,500 sq. ft., featuring a luxury transitional and modern-classic design style with detailed architectural elements, decorative wall paneling, custom ceiling designs, and integrated lighting. We already have architectural floor plans, dimensions, and design inspiration images. We are looking for someone who can translate our ideas into professional, accurate, and detailed design presentations. Scope of Work High-quality, photorealistic 3D interior renderings. Detailed 2D wall elevations with accurate dimensions. Custom wall paneling, decorative mouldings, and millwork designs. Reflected ceiling plans (RCPs), including recessed ceilings, bulkheads, curtain coves, and lighting. Cross-sections and construction details for framing and installation. Material, colour, and finish recommendations. Professional presentation sheets combining 3D renderings, 2D elevations, dimensions, and material specifications. Project Requirements All designs must follow our existing architectural drawings and actual dimensions. We prefer a sophisticated, timeless luxury aesthetic. Renderings must accurately represent the proposed construction details. Final drawings should be practical for contractors and trades to execute. Deliverables should include editable CAD files, high-resolution renderings, and PDF presentation sheets. Ideal Candidate We are looking for someone with experience in high-end residential interior design, architectural detailing, AutoCAD, SketchUp, 3ds Max, Revit, or similar software. Please share examples of previous luxury residential projects, particularly those involving detailed wall elevations, decorative ceilings, and custom millwork. We would like to begin with one room or wall elevation as an initial project, with the possibility of continuing throughout the entire home if the quality and communication meet our expectations. Please provide your portfolio, estimated turnaround time, and pricing structure. We look forward to working with a talented designer on this project.

opportunities.title: Dynamics 365 Technical Consultant
opportunities.description: I want an experienced Dynamics 365 professional who can jump in quickly, assess where I am, and guide the platform to a cleaner, faster, better-aligned state. At this point the exact module mix (Sales, Customer Service, Finance & Operations, or a blend) is still open; the first task will be a brief discovery session so you understand the processes and pain points. Once we agree on priorities, you will carry out the hands-on technical work—whether that means configuring entities and workflows, streamlining performance bottlenecks, building Power BI dashboards, integrating external data through the Dataverse/API layer, or setting up automated routines with Power Automate. Clear documentation and a short knowledge-transfer session at the end of each milestone are essential so my in-house team can take over day-to-day administration. Deliverables • Discovery findings & implementation roadmap • Configured/customised Dynamics 365 environment (with solution files) • Integration or automation scripts as applicable • User-ready documentation and quick-reference guide Success will be measured by a smoothly running instance, faster task completion for end users, and clean hand-off documentation. If that sounds like your wheelhouse, let’s schedule a short call to confirm scope and timeline.

opportunities.title: Collect and annotate 1,200 real phone screenshots (adult and graphic-injury content) for a child-safety AI model: adults only
opportunities.description: CensorX is an Android child-safety app. An on-device AI model detects adult content and graphic injury on a child’s screen and blurs it before the child sees it. To work well, the model must learn what unsafe content looks like on a real phone screen. This job supplies that training data. Every image will be used only to train and test this detection model, and will never be published or redistributed. Content warning This job involves viewing explicit adult material and graphic images of wounds and blood. Apply only if you are 18 or older and comfortable working with this content. You confirm that you are 18 or older. What you will deliver: 1,400 annotated screenshots Folder Count Content unsafe/adult 700 Phone screenshots showing adult nudity or sexual content in realistic screen settings (browser, search results, feeds) unsafe/wound_blood 700 Phone screenshots in which real, visible wounds or blood on people are clearly shown (injury, first-aid, medical, news, fight footage), in the same screen settings The counts are targets; ±5% per folder is fine. At least 40% of the wound/blood images must show the injury at a distance (wide shot, crowd or ring scenes, video frames), not only close-ups. For adult content, cover a mix of skin tones, body types, genders, settings, and sizes of the unsafe region, including small or partly visible regions and screens where the unsafe content is only one tile in a grid. Annotation (bounding boxes) Draw one tight box around each visible unsafe region in every image. The label is unsafe for both folders. Box small, partly hidden and low-resolution unsafe regions too, and box each region separately. Do not box blurred, covered or censored areas. Deliver YOLO .txt files (one per image, same file name) or COCO JSON. Images and labels must match one to one. A short guide with examples of correct and incorrect boxes will be provided after hiring. Content rules Adults only. If you cannot clearly tell that every person shown is an adult, do not use the image. Absolutely no content involving minors, ever. If you come across it, do not save or share it, delete it, and report it to the relevant authorities (in India, the national cybercrime portal). Any such image in a delivery means immediate termination and no payment for that batch. No private, leaked, hacked, hidden-camera, revenge or non-consensual material. Use only sources with documented age and consent verification. Only publicly accessible content. Do not use paywalled, login-protected or restricted material, and do not bypass any access control. Real photos and real video frames only. No AI-generated images. Exclude anime, cartoon and game blood, and clearly staged makeup. Do not include weapons or fights without visible blood or injury. Capture requirements Take every screenshot on a real Android phone, in portrait orientation. Automation is allowed for scrolling and screen capture only (for example ADB screencap or a scripted scroll-and-capture routine). Emulators, desktop browsers, downloaded or scraped images, screen recordings, and AI-generated or composited images are not allowed. Screenshots taken while a video is playing in the browser are allowed. Recorded video is not. Submit the original, unmodified PNG files exactly as the phone captured them. Do not crop, edit, resize, filter or recompress anything. Required size: 1080 px wide (for example 1080×2340 or 1080×2400). Tell us your phone model. With the trial, include one screenshot of the phone’s Settings, About phone page, showing the model, so that we can verify the device. Screenshots must show the full phone screen, including the status bar and navigation bar. Realizo **bioconstrucción en guadua, muro tendinoso con botellas y vidrio, todo tipo de cubiertas y estructuras en metal/soldadura, café especial borbón rosado, murales artísticos, modelado 3D en Blender y planos**.

📲 Contacto directo en San Agustín, Huila (Colombia): **+57 322 273 9034**.

opportunities.title: Bot WhatsApp Respuestas Automáticas
opportunities.description: Quiero poner en marcha un asistente que conteste de forma automática las preguntas frecuentes que recibo por WhatsApp. Alcance del trabajo • Configurar un número nuevo de WhatsApp Business – no usaré el que ya tengo. • Crear el bot para que responda únicamente a partir de la lista de preguntas y respuestas que proporcionaré. No hay que buscar información en la web ni en documentos adicionales. • Asegurar que cada mensaje del cliente se analice y se envíe la respuesta adecuada de inmediato, manteniendo el formato y tono que yo indicaré. • Entregarme un panel básico o un método claro para actualizar las respuestas cuando cambien. Entregables 1. Nº de WhatsApp Business operativo con el asistente activo. 2. Archivo o consola donde pueda modificar las Q&A fácilmente. 3. Breve guía paso a paso para que el equipo sepa pausar, reanudar o escalar una conversación a un agente humano cuando sea necesario. Aprecio soluciones que utilicen plataformas conocidas (p.ej. Twilio, Dialogflow, ManyChat) siempre que el coste mensual sea razonable y la propiedad de los datos quede de mi lado. Quedo atento a tus propuestas técnicas y al plazo estimado para dejar el bot funcionando.

opportunities.title: Experienced Sales Representative for Skillitize India PVT. LTD
opportunities.description: Your primary responsibility will be to convert the leads provided by Skillitize into course enrollments. There is no fixed salary. You will earn based on the successful conversions generated from the leads assigned to you. ₹100- ₹400 Key responsibilities include: * Call each assigned lead and introduce Skillitize and the relevant course. * Understand the candidate’s educational background, career goals, and requirements. * Explain the course curriculum, benefits, duration, certification, internship/project opportunities, and pricing. * Handle questions and objections raised by prospective students. * Follow up with interested candidates through phone/WhatsApp as required. * Maintain regular communication with leads until the final decision. * Convince and convert qualified/interested prospects into paid enrollments. * Coordinate with the Skillitize team regarding successful conversions and payment confirmation. * Maintain basic records of calls, follow-ups, lead status, and conversions. * Follow professional and ethical sales practices while representing Skillitize Compensation Structure This is a commission/revenue-sharing based freelance role. For every lead that you successfully convert into a paid Skillitize customer, you will receive an agreed percentage/share of the revenue generated from that enrollment. * Leads will be provided by Skillitize. * Commission will be applicable only to successfully completed/verified paid enrollments. * Lead ownership and conversion tracking will be maintained by Skillitize. * Payment to the freelancer will be processed according to the mutually agreed payment cycle. * All customer payments will be made through the official payment channels provided by Skillitize. We are looking for someone who: * Has experience in tele-sales, inside sales, education sales, EdTech sales, or business development. * Has excellent communication and convincing skills. * Is comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls. * Can effectively handle sales objections. * Is good at follow-ups and relationship building. * Can understand customer requirements and recommend the appropriate course. * Is target-oriented and motivated by performance-based earnings. * Can work independently and manage assigned leads responsibly.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40804659, publicado hace 3 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 500 - 1,000.

opportunities.title: SEO y Redes Sociales para E-commerce
opportunities.description: Tengo una tienda en línea de productos físicos y necesito una estrategia combinada de SEO y redes sociales que se centre, ante todo, en generar más clientes y ventas. Quiero que optimices mi sitio para buscadores (on-page y off-page), diseñes un calendario de contenidos atractivo y gestiones mis perfiles principales — Instagram, Facebook y TikTok — de forma coherente con la marca. Entrego acceso a Google Analytics, Search Console y a las cuentas sociales; tú te encargas de planificar, ejecutar y medir los resultados. Entregables clave: • Auditoría SEO inicial con lista priorizada de acciones. • Optimización de keywords, meta-tags, velocidad y estructura interna. • Estrategia de contenidos y anuncios para redes enfocada en conversiones. • Diseño y programación de publicaciones durante el primer mes. • Reporte con métricas de tráfico, engagement y ventas atribuibles. Valoraré experiencia demostrable en e-commerce, casos de éxito y dominio de herramientas como SEMrush, Ahrefs o Meta Ads Manager. Si te apasiona escalar tiendas online, espero tu propuesta.

opportunities.title: Urgent ETABS Analysis for Water Tank
opportunities.description: I have a nearly-finished 2D AutoCAD drawing (about 98 % complete, grids included) for a small 1 800 mm × 1 800 mm water tank with a 1 100 mm wall height. I now need you to take that file, build a quick ETABS model, and deliver a concise report that lists both the base reactions and the joint displacements. Timing is critical: I must have the model and the report back within the next 3–4 hours. If you find any minor tweaks are required while modelling, just flag them so I can adjust the CAD and return it immediately—we can keep the feedback loop tight. Please use ETABS (any recent version you are comfortable with). The final hand-off should include: • the ETABS .edb file, ready for my records • a PDF (or Excel) summary showing the requested base reactions and joint displacement values for the governing load cases That’s all. Once I receive those two items on time, the job is complete.

opportunities.title: Odoo-Based E-Commerce Store Setup
opportunities.description: I’m launching an online store for physical products and want the entire shopping experience built on the Odoo website builder. The catalogue will need clear categories, search and filter options, and, of course, a smooth shopping-cart flow through checkout. Razorpay must handle payments, while Shiprocket will provide real-time rates, label creation, and tracking notifications. Customers should be able to create accounts so they can review past purchases and follow their delivery status at any time. WhatsApp is another key touchpoint: visitors should be able to click a chat icon to ask pre-sale questions, request help with an existing order, or even place an order directly from the conversation. The WhatsApp workflow has to sync back to the Odoo backend so that no order or ticket is lost. Deliverables (all items are completion requirements): • Fully responsive Odoo website with product catalogue, search & filters, cart, and Razorpay-powered checkout • Shiprocket integration configured for rate lookup, label printing, and status updates inside Odoo • WhatsApp API/Business integration enabling chat, order help, and direct order placement, all linked to customer records • Customer account area showing order history and live tracking • Final deployment on my domain with test data cleared and a short handover guide covering payment, shipping, and WhatsApp workflows I’ll consider the project finished once I can run a live test order: payment captured through Razorpay, shipping label generated via Shiprocket, and an automatic WhatsApp confirmation sent to the customer—all reflected correctly in Odoo’s backend.

opportunities.title: WordPress Pages, Popups, SEO Revamp
opportunities.description: My WordPress site needs a three-fold tune-up: fresh pages, smarter pop-ups, and an SEO deep clean geared toward driving more calls, messages, and quote requests. Pages • Refresh several existing service pages so they answer common questions, build trust, and clearly funnel visitors to phone, WhatsApp, or the quote form. • Add a handful of new pages where gaps exist, keeping the same brand voice and design language so the whole site feels seamless. Pop-ups • Audit the current pop-ups, scrap what isn’t converting, and create persuasive new offers (exit-intent, time-delay, mobile friendly) that collect leads without being intrusive. • Style them to match the site, connect them to my email/CRM tool, and A/B test copy and timing for best performance. SEO • Run a full technical and on-page audit, fix critical issues (meta titles, broken links, schema, image optimisation), and tighten the site structure. • Deliver a batch of fresh keyword-focused meta tags and headlines, plus an internal-linking plan that helps key pages rank higher. Visitor intelligence without forms The final piece is tracking visitor details—ideally company name, location, and publicly available contact data—even when they never fill out a form. I’m open to whichever solution you recommend (e.g., reverse IP lookup, intent-data tools, or privacy-compliant plugins) as long as it integrates neatly with WordPress and funnels insights into Google Analytics and my CRM. Acceptance criteria 1. New/updated pages published and passing Core Web Vitals. 2. Pop-ups live, connected to email/CRM, and showing initial conversion metrics. 3. SEO audit fixes implemented with before/after report. 4. Visitor-tracking tool installed, tested, and feeding identifiable data into a dashboard I can access. If something is unclear, flag it early so we keep momentum. Looking forward to a measurable lift in traffic quality and inbound enquiries once this goes live. Note: Don't bid a bogus price.

opportunities.title: Freelance Sales Partner for Zoho Implementation Services (Remote, Any Country)
opportunities.description: Looking for freelance B2B sales partners to sell Zoho implementation services. Remote, performance-based, open to any country. About us: Code-End IT Solutions (India) delivers Zoho CRM, Books, Inventory, Creator, integrations, automation and data migration remotely for SMEs. You find the clients, we handle the delivery. What you will do: - Find SMEs, accountants, bookkeepers, traders and e-commerce sellers in your market who need Zoho setup, cleanup or migration - Share our pitch and book qualified requirement calls or demos - (Model 2 only) Run the demo and close the deal yourself How you earn (performance-based): - Model 1, Referral: 10% commission on every closed project. You share the client's requirement, we handle the demo and delivery. - Model 2, Sales Partner: 15% commission. You also run the demo and close the deal, we handle delivery only. - A small fixed payment for each qualified meeting booked (to be discussed) - Commission is paid after the client's payment is received. No hourly pay. We provide: Pitch scripts, demo videos, a rate card, message templates and a requirement form. You are a good fit if: - You have experience in B2B, IT or software sales, or a strong network among SMEs or accountants in your country - You communicate well in written English and are comfortable on LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp and calls - Zoho, CRM, ERP or accounting software experience is a plus To apply, include in your proposal (proposals without these will be skipped): 1. Your country and the type of businesses you can reach this month 2. One example of a software or IT service you have sold or referred before 3. A 4-line pitch you would send to a business owner about our Zoho services 4. Which model suits you (1 or 2) We start with a 2-week trial: 2-3 qualified requirement calls. No accounts, IDs or payments are required from you at any stage.

opportunities.title: Desarrollo de Plataforma de Contenido de Video con Ia para Redes So...
opportunities.description: Buscamos un desarrollador con experiencia en Inteligencia Artificial para crear una plataforma integral que automatice la creación, edición y publicación de videos en redes sociales. Esta solución innovadora permitirá a los usuarios optimizar su estrategia de contenido de video de manera eficiente y escalable. Las funcionalidades clave que deberá incluir la plataforma son: - Generación automática de videos utilizando IA: Esto abarca la creación de guiones, la selección de imágenes, la generación de voces, la adición de subtítulos y la edición completa del video. - Automatización de la publicación de contenido: La plataforma debe ser capaz de publicar videos de forma automática en las principales redes sociales como Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, entre otras. - Programación y gestión de calendario de contenido: Herramientas para programar publicaciones con antelación y gestionar un calendario editorial completo. - Administración de múltiples cuentas y perfiles: Posibilidad de gestionar varias cuentas y perfiles de redes sociales desde una única interfaz centralizada. - Dashboard de monitoreo y análisis: Un panel de control intuitivo para monitorear el rendimiento de las publicaciones, visualizar métricas clave y analizar los resultados obtenidos. - Gestión automatizada de procesos: La plataforma debe gestionar de forma autónoma los procesos de generación y publicación de contenido. Es fundamental que la solución sea escalable y permita integraciones fluidas con diferentes proveedores de IA y APIs de redes sociales para asegurar su adaptabilidad y crecimiento futuro. Se valorará altamente la experiencia previa en el desarrollo de plataformas SaaS, conocimientos en IA generativa, automatización de workflows y procesamiento de video. Los interesados deben presentar su experiencia en proyectos similares, una propuesta técnica detallada, los tiempos estimados para el desarrollo y el presupuesto requerido. Categoría: Programación y Tecnología Subcategoría: Inteligencia Artificial Tamaño del proyecto: Medio

opportunities.title: Dual-Band 1×8/1×16 Antenna Design
opportunities.description: I need a dual-band microstrip patch antenna array built in both 1×8 and 1×16 configurations( objective no. 2 in the reference document uploaded). The arrays must cover two strictly defined bands—5.925 GHz-6.425 GHz and 6.725 GHz-7.025 GHz—with a tolerance no wider than ±1 MHz across the entire aperture. Target max.broadside gains are roughly 14 dB for the 1×8 and 17 dB for the 1×16, as observable in the 3D radiation plot. Provide base patch file also. Provide not just the file but also the results folder so that it is ready to be executed right away on Ansys HFSS 2025 R1 software. These are the basic requirements. Cooperation required if some modifications are requested.

opportunities.title: Precise 3D-Printable Product Model
opportunities.description: I have a product or object that I need translated into an accurate, watertight 3D model for 3D printing. To guide you, I’ll supply high-resolution photos from several angles so you can capture every contour and proportion. Your task is to recreate the item faithfully, keeping wall thickness and overhang considerations in mind so the file prints cleanly on an FDM or resin machine. I’m happy to answer questions about scale or tolerances as you work. Deliverables • Finished, error-free STL (and, if possible, the original editable file—e.g., STEP, OBJ, or BLEND) • One minor revision round after I test the slice for printability If you’re comfortable turning photographic references into print-ready geometry, I’d love to see a brief note about similar pieces you’ve modelled. Looking forward to collaborating!

opportunities.title: Siemens PLC/HMI Chamber Automation
opportunities.description: I need a Siemens-based control program that will run fully automatic temperature-and-humidity test cycles in a cascade chamber. The core logic must handle ramp, soak, and dwell sequences accurately, driving the chamber’s cooling, heating, humidification, and de-humidification elements while maintaining tight tolerances. The HMI (WinCC Comfort or Advanced) has to let an operator: • start or stop the current cycle and follow real-time values; • create, edit, and save custom temperature-humidity “recipes”; • see active alarms and download historical data or PDF/CSV reports directly to USB or the plant network. I will provide the P & ID, I/O list, and existing electrical drawings. You will deliver the TIA Portal project file, HMI runtime files, and a brief commissioning checklist so I can load, test, and sign off on site. Please code to Siemens best practices—structured blocks, named tags, and clear comments—so future maintenance is straightforward. If you’ve commissioned environmental chambers before and can demonstrate solid experience with TIA Portal, Step 7, and WinCC, I’d like to hear how quickly you can turn the logic, screens, and documentation around.

opportunities.description: Helpdesk Automation: Business Requirements Nov 4, 2026 · Fatai This document defines two automated request types: Pepperi credential requests and new SAP user creation. Any other request goes to the L1 helpdesk. 1. Scope In scope • Credential requests (login, password, or access) for an existing Pepperi account. • New SAP user creation, requested from the SAP Accounting team by email. Out of scope • Other software, hardware, and access requests. • Elevated or admin roles. • SAP role assignment and job-title mapping. • Creating Pepperi accounts. • Any task the helpdesk has not delegated to the automation. 2. Intake • Trigger: an email from Spiceworks for a new ticket. There is no polling. • Required ticket fields: ticket number, requester name and email, summary, description, category, and ticket type. • The requester must be an employee on an allowed domain: gmfoods.com, ziyad.com, globalchoicefoods.com, or pepperi.com (see open item 4). • If a required field is missing, email the requester for it. 3. Classification • Credential request: asks for a login, password, or access to an existing Pepperi account. • New user request: asks for a new SAP user. • Anything else, or anything unclear: route to the helpdesk. 4. Workflow 1: Credential request Inputs: the Pepperi account ID and username from the ticket, and the requester's email address. 1. Look up the credential in the data source (open item 1), using the ticket parameters. 2. If the lookup finds no match, route to the helpdesk. If it finds more than one match, email the requester to confirm the account, then wait for the reply. 3. Email the credential to the requester. 4. Update the ticket and write the audit record. Credential values are never written to the ticket or the audit record. 5. Workflow 2: New user creation (SAP) Required: email address (unique ID) and store name. SAP accepts only these two for a new account. 1. Check that both required fields are present. If either is missing, email the requester for it. 2. Check that the requester is a Business Manager or GM Foods employee. If not, route to the helpdesk. 3. Get Accounting Manager approval, by reply or approval record. 4. Search SAP by store name and email address. If a match exists, route to the helpdesk. 5. Email the SAP Accounting team to create the user, with the user's email address and the store name. 6. When the Accounting team confirms creation, email the result to the requester with the Business Manager in CC. Then update the ticket and write the audit record. 6. Shared rules • Ticket updates use Spiceworks email commands: assign, close, and add time. Category, ticket type, and processing result still need a method (open item 5). • Exceptions go to the helpdesk queue, with the reason in an internal note. The helpdesk receives an alert for each exception. • On a system error, retry once. If the retry fails, route to the helpdesk. • Every ticket gets an audit record: ticket number, request type, classification, lookup or match result, approval, action and outcome, and final status. Audit records never contain credential values. 7. Automation levels Scenario Handling Credential request, one match Automated Credential request, more than one match Automated: email the requester to confirm Credential request, no match Helpdesk New user, both fields present, approved, no duplicate Automated New user, a required field missing Automated: email the requester New user with a duplicate, missing approval, or unauthorized requester Helpdesk Anything unclear or not listed here Helpdesk 8. Reporting A monthly report is produced from the audit trail and ticket data: • Volume by request type, with automated and helpdesk counts. • Exception counts by reason. • Median time from ticket creation to resolution. • Failed actions and retries. 9. Open items 1. Data source for credentials: Excel, SQL, SAP, or other. Which system holds the credentials, and which ticket parameters identify the user. 2. Whether a requester may receive credentials for an account they do not own. 3. How the Accounting team confirms creation (reply or other method), and the Accounting team's email address. 4. Allowed domains: confirm whether pepperi.com stays on the list, since it is a vendor domain. 5. How ticket category, ticket type, and processing result are set, since no email command covers them. 6. Accounting Manager approval record accepted, approval timeout, and the approver list. 7. Pepperi account ID format. IDs are 5-digit numbers, with prefixes such as C#, BP, and #. 8. Time to Resolve units in the Spiceworks export (assumed minutes). 9. Whether email is approved for sending credentials. Assumptions • Spiceworks is the system of record for requests and responses. • Intake is triggered by email. There is no Spiceworks API. • Credential values are never stored in Spiceworks or in audit records. Appendix: October 2026 Spiceworks export The export covers 790 tickets, with 761 closed and 29 open. Approximate counts from keyword rules, spot-checked by hand: • 116 Pepperi credential or login requests: Workflow 1. • 37 Pepperi account creation requests: routed to the helpdesk, since Pepperi account creation is out of scope. • 17 HR new-hire and access-change forms: Workflow 2 applies to the new-hire forms. • About 290 alerts and notifications, such as password expiry reports and phishing alerts: not requests, and filtered out at intake.

opportunities.title: AI-Powered Laundry system
opportunities.description: This project is to develop, and deploy a end-to-end operational automation solution for an Laundry. The objective is to replace the existing system with an AI-driven vision system for handwritten order recognition using tablet, order binding, automate trolley tracking via QR code scan and Bluetooth barcode scanner and scale integration, enable offline-first mobile workflows (PWA) in low-signal environments. The system will run on a local server architecture (.NET 8 / IIS / MSSQL) with real-time analytics and automated statement generation and Text-to-SQL report generation Preferred approach A lightweight web application (responsive) that runs in any modern browser on our PCs and tablets. I’m comfortable with stacks such as MS IIS + . NET8(ASP.NET Code web API) + MS SQL as long as the code is well-structured and documented. Please include an estimated timeline and note any similar systems you have built. I’m ready to start as soon as I find the right developer.

opportunities.title: AutoCAD & SolidWorks CAD Modelling
opportunities.description: I need a skilled CAD partner who can take a product made of several assembled parts from concept to manufacturing-ready documentation. Using AutoCAD you will draft precise 2D technical drawings, then shift into SolidWorks to build individual part models, combine them into an accurate assembly, and generate clear, dimensioned engineering drawings. The core of this assignment is converting my existing sketches and partial files into a fully detailed digital package. Along the way you may need to clean up or revise earlier versions, so a sharp eye for consistency and tolerances is essential. Please focus your proposal on your hands-on experience with AutoCAD and SolidWorks for product development—especially projects where you handled both 2D drafting and 3D assemblies. Attach a couple of relevant screenshots or brief case notes that prove you have delivered similar, multi-component jobs before. Deliverables • AutoCAD 2D drawings of each component • SolidWorks part files and complete assembly • Updated or modified versions of any legacy CAD I provide • Manufacturing-ready drawings with accurate dimensions and annotations Once we agree on milestones, I will send reference files, sketches, and any standards you need to follow. Accuracy and attention to detail matter more to me than speed, but an efficient turnaround will certainly help us both. I look forward to seeing how your expertise can bring this product to life in the digital workspace.

opportunities.description: Ausschreibung: Entwicklung und Bau eines funktionsfähigen Prototyps – AromaWash Projekt: AromaWash – Automatischer Seifenspender mit integrierter Duftabgabe Auftrag: Umsetzung einer vorhandenen Konstruktion zu einem vollständig funktionsfähigen technischen Prototypen. Standort des Auftragnehmers: Weltweit, bevorzugt Deutschland, Europa oder Asien. 1. Projektbeschreibung Für das Produkt AromaWash suche ich einen erfahrenen Freelancer, Entwickler oder ein Ingenieurteam, das eine bereits vorhandene Produktkonstruktion in einen vollständig funktionsfähigen Prototypen umsetzt. AromaWash ist ein automatischer Seifenspender mit integriertem elektronisch gesteuertem Duftabgabesystem. Die mechanische Konstruktion sowie die technischen Unterlagen einschließlich der vorgesehenen elektronischen Komponenten und deren Einbaupositionen liegen bereits vor. Es geht ausdrücklich nicht um eine komplette Neuentwicklung, sondern um die praktische Umsetzung der bestehenden Konstruktion. 2. Technische Produktbeschreibung Das Gerät verfügt über folgende Eigenschaften: - Ovales Kunststoffgehäuse - Fassungsvermögen des Seifenbehälters: ca. 500 ml - Automatischer Seifenspender mit Sensorsteuerung - Separates Duftmodul im unteren Gehäusebereich - Austauschbare Duftkartusche - Elektronisch gesteuerte Duftabgabe - Kleiner Ventilator zur Verteilung des Duftes - Bewegungssensor zur Erkennung der Händewaschbewegung - Zeitverzögerte Steuerung der Duftabgabe - Sperrzeit zur Vermeidung eines permanenten oder zu häufigen Ventilatorbetriebs - Batteriebetrieb - Wandmontage oder freistehende Verwendung Die vorhandenen Konstruktions- und Elektronikunterlagen werden dem ausgewählten Auftragnehmer zur Verfügung gestellt. 3. Leistungsumfang Der Auftragnehmer soll folgende Arbeiten vollständig übernehmen: A. Prüfung und Vorbereitung - Prüfung der vorhandenen CAD-Konstruktion und technischen Unterlagen - Prüfung der vorgesehenen elektronischen Komponenten - Feststellung eventuell notwendiger Anpassungen - Abstimmung vor Beginn der Fertigung B. Beschaffung der Komponenten - Eigenständige Beschaffung sämtlicher benötigter Bauteile - Beschaffung von Sensoren, Platinen, Ventilator, Batterieversorgung, Kabeln und Verbindungselementen - Beschaffung der mechanischen Komponenten - Verwendung geeigneter und möglichst handelsüblicher Standardbauteile C. Mechanische Umsetzung - Herstellung des Kunststoffgehäuses auf Grundlage der vorhandenen Konstruktion - Vorzugsweise 3D-Druck für den ersten Prototypen - Einbau und Befestigung sämtlicher Komponenten - Herstellung der erforderlichen Aussparungen und Befestigungen D. Elektronik und Steuerung - Aufbau und Integration der Elektronik - Anschluss und Programmierung der Sensorsteuerung - Ansteuerung des Duftventilators - Umsetzung der vorgesehenen Zeitsteuerung und Sperrzeiten - Integration der Batterieversorgung - Prüfung der elektrischen Funktionen E. Zusammenbau und Funktionstest - Vollständige Montage des Gerätes - Überprüfung aller mechanischen und elektronischen Funktionen - Test des Seifenspenders - Test der automatischen Duftabgabe - Prüfung der Sensorerkennung - Prüfung des Batteriebetriebs - Behebung eventuell auftretender Fehler 4. Verbindliche Dokumentation und Komponentenliste Ein wesentlicher Bestandteil des Auftrags ist eine vollständige technische Dokumentation. Der Auftragnehmer muss eine übersichtliche Komponentenliste (BOM – Bill of Materials) erstellen. Für jedes einzelne Bauteil sind folgende Angaben erforderlich: Angabe| Anforderung Bauteilbezeichnung| Vollständiger Name Hersteller| Herstellername Artikelnummer| Exakte Bestellnummer Bezugsquelle| Lieferant bzw. Händler Internetadresse| Direkter Produktlink Einzelpreis| Tatsächlicher Einkaufspreis Anzahl| Benötigte Stückzahl Funktion| Technischer Verwendungszweck Die Komponentenliste muss sämtliche mechanischen und elektronischen Bauteile umfassen. Zusätzlich sind die tatsächlichen Bezugsquellen und möglichst alternative Lieferanten anzugeben. Ziel ist, dass sämtliche Komponenten später jederzeit nachbestellt werden können. 5. Zu übergebende Arbeitsergebnisse Nach Abschluss des Auftrags müssen folgende Ergebnisse vorliegen: 1. Zwei vollständig funktionsfähige und montierte AromaWash-Prototypen. 2. Vollständige Komponentenliste mit Artikelnummern und Bezugsquellen. 3. Stückliste mit Einkaufspreisen. 4. Elektronischer Schaltplan. 5. Platinenlayout und Fertigungsdaten, sofern eine eigene Platine eingesetzt wird. 6. Sämtliche neu erstellten CAD- und 3D-Druckdateien. 7. Steuerungssoftware einschließlich Quellcode. 8. Technische Dokumentation der Elektronik und Verkabelung. 9. Kurze Bedienungs- und Funktionsbeschreibung. 10. Dokumentation der durchgeführten Funktionstests. Alle projektspezifischen Entwicklungs- und Fertigungsdateien sind dem Auftraggeber zu übergeben. 6. Anforderungen an den Freelancer Gesucht wird ein erfahrener Entwickler oder ein Team mit nachweisbaren Kenntnissen in: - Mechatronik und Produktentwicklung - Elektronikentwicklung - Mikrocontroller und Sensorsteuerung - Embedded Software und Firmware - 3D-CAD und Kunststoffgehäusen - Prototypenbau und Geräteintegration - Beschaffung elektronischer Komponenten Erfahrungen mit batteriebetriebenen Haushaltsgeräten, Seifenspendern oder Duftspendern sind von Vorteil. Bitte stellen Sie vergleichbare Projekte und Referenzen vor. 7. Angebot und Kosten Bitte unterbreiten Sie ein verbindliches Angebot für die vollständige Umsetzung. Das Angebot soll getrennt ausweisen: - Entwicklungs- und Arbeitskosten - Kosten sämtlicher Bauteile - Kosten für Gehäuse und Fertigung - Montage und Funktionstest - Versand nach Deutschland - Voraussichtliche Lieferzeit Bitte geben Sie auch an, ob die Arbeiten als Festpreisprojekt durchgeführt werden können. 8. Geheimhaltung und Rechte Vor Übergabe der technischen Unterlagen ist eine Geheimhaltungsvereinbarung (NDA) abzuschließen. Alle projektspezifisch erstellten Entwicklungs-, Konstruktions-, Elektronik- und Softwaredateien müssen nach vollständiger Bezahlung dem Auftraggeber mit den erforderlichen Nutzungs- und Verwertungsrechten übergeben werden. Eine Weitergabe oder anderweitige Verwendung der vertraulichen Produktunterlagen ist nicht gestattet. 9. Ziel des Auftrags Ziel ist die Herstellung eines vollständig funktionsfähigen AromaWash-Prototyps, der sämtliche vorgesehenen mechanischen und elektronischen Funktionen erfüllt. Der Prototyp soll als Grundlage für weitere Tests, Produktoptimierungen und eine spätere Serienfertigung dienen. Bitte bewerben Sie sich nur, wenn Sie in der Lage sind, das komplette Gerät einschließlich Beschaffung, Elektronik, mechanischer Umsetzung und Montage funktionsfähig zu liefern. Ich freue mich auf aussagekräftige Angebote mit Referenzen, Kostenaufstellung und Zeitplanung.

Beschaffung der Komponenten - Eigenständige Beschaffung sämtlicher benötigter Bauteile - Beschaffung von Sensoren, Platinen, Ventilator, Batterieversorgung, Kabeln und Verbindungselementen - Beschaffung der mechanischen Komponenten - Verwendung geeigneter und möglichst handelsüblicher Standardbauteile C. Mechanische Umsetzung - Herstellung des Kunststoffgehäuses auf Grundlage der vorhandenen Konstruktion - Vorzugsweise 3D-Druck für den ersten Prototypen - Einbau und Befestigung sämtlicher Komponenten - Herstellung der erforderlichen Aussparungen und Befestigungen D. Elektronik und Steuerung - Aufbau und Integration der Elektronik - Anschluss und Programmierung der Sensorsteuerung - Ansteuerung des Duftventilators - Umsetzung der vorgesehenen Zeitsteuerung und Sperrzeiten - Integration der Batterieversorgung - Prüfung der elektrischen Funktionen E. Zusammenbau und Funktionstest - Vollständige Montage des Gerätes - Überprüfung aller mechanischen und elektronischen Funktionen - Test des Seifenspenders - Test der automatischen Duftabgabe - Prüfung der Sensorerkennung - Prüfung des Batteriebetriebs - Behebung eventuell auftretender Fehler 4. Verbindliche Dokumentation und Komponentenliste Ein wesentlicher Bestandteil des Auftrags ist eine vollständige technische Dokumentation. Der Auftragnehmer muss eine übersichtliche Komponentenliste (BOM – Bill of Materials) erstellen. Für jedes einzelne Bauteil sind folgende Angaben erforderlich: Angabe| Anforderung Bauteilbezeichnung| Vollständiger Name Hersteller| Herstellername Artikelnummer| Exakte Bestellnummer Bezugsquelle| Lieferant bzw. Händler Internetadresse| Direkter Produktlink Einzelpreis| Tatsächlicher Einkaufspreis Anzahl| Benötigte Stückzahl Funktion| Technischer Verwendungszweck Die Komponentenliste muss sämtliche mechanischen und elektronischen Bauteile umfassen. Zusätzlich sind die tatsächlichen Bezugsquellen und möglichst alternative Lieferanten anzugeben. Ziel ist, dass sämtliche Komponenten später jederzeit nachbestellt werden können. 5. Zu übergebende Arbeitsergebnisse Nach Abschluss des Auftrags müssen folgende Ergebnisse vorliegen: 1. Zwei vollständig funktionsfähige und montierte AromaWash-Prototypen. 2. Vollständige Komponentenliste mit Artikelnummern und Bezugsquellen. 3. Stückliste mit Einkaufspreisen. 4. Elektronischer Schaltplan. 5. Platinenlayout und Fertigungsdaten, sofern eine eigene Platine eingesetzt wird. 6. Sämtliche neu erstellten CAD- und 3D-Druckdateien. 7. Steuerungssoftware einschließlich Quellcode. 8. Technische Dokumentation der Elektronik und Verkabelung. 9. Kurze Bedienungs- und Funktionsbeschreibung. 10. Dokumentation der durchgeführten Funktionstests. Alle projektspezifischen Entwicklungs- und Fertigungsdateien sind dem Auftraggeber zu übergeben. 6. Anforderungen an den Freelancer Gesucht wird ein erfahrener Entwickler oder ein Team mit nachweisbaren Kenntnissen in: - Mechatronik und Produktentwicklung - Elektronikentwicklung - Mikrocontroller und Sensorsteuerung - Embedded Software und Firmware - 3D-CAD und Kunststoffgehäusen - Prototypenbau und Geräteintegration - Beschaffung elektronischer Komponenten Erfahrungen mit batteriebetriebenen Haushaltsgeräten, Seifenspendern oder Duftspendern sind von Vorteil. Bitte stellen Sie vergleichbare Projekte und Referenzen vor. 7. Angebot und Kosten Bitte unterbreiten Sie ein verbindliches Angebot für die vollständige Umsetzung. Das Angebot soll getrennt ausweisen: - Entwicklungs- und Arbeitskosten - Kosten sämtlicher Bauteile - Kosten für Gehäuse und Fertigung - Montage und Funktionstest - Versand nach Deutschland - Voraussichtliche Lieferzeit Bitte geben Sie auch an, ob die Arbeiten als Festpreisprojekt durchgeführt werden können. 8. Geheimhaltung und Rechte Vor Übergabe der technischen Unterlagen ist eine Geheimhaltungsvereinbarung (NDA) abzuschließen. Alle projektspezifisch erstellten Entwicklungs-, Konstruktions-, Elektronik- und Softwaredateien müssen nach vollständiger Bezahlung dem Auftraggeber mit den erforderlichen Nutzungs- und Verwertungsrechten übergeben werden. Eine Weitergabe oder anderweitige Verwendung der vertraulichen Produktunterlagen ist nicht gestattet. 9. Ziel des Auftrags Ziel ist die Herstellung eines vollständig funktionsfähigen AromaWash-Prototyps, der sämtliche vorgesehenen mechanischen und elektronischen Funktionen erfüllt. Der Prototyp soll als Grundlage für weitere Tests, Produktoptimierungen und eine spätere Serienfertigung dienen. Bitte bewerben Sie sich nur, wenn Sie in der Lage sind, das komplette Gerät einschließlich Beschaffung, Elektronik, mechanischer Umsetzung und Montage funktionsfähig zu liefern. Ich freue mich auf aussagekräftige Angebote mit Referenzen, Kostenaufstellung und Zeitplanung."

opportunities.title: Spanish Red Wine Tasting Notes -- 2
opportunities.description: Necesito redactar un conjunto de notas de cata en español centradas exclusivamente en vinos tintos. El tono debe ser cercano y fácil de entender para cualquier lector, evitando tecnicismos excesivos pero sin sacrificar precisión sensorial. Estas descripciones se imprimirán en una carta de vinos y en otro material físico, de modo que deben leerse bien en papel, ser breves, claras y transmitir la personalidad de cada vino al primer vistazo. Si no puede presentar una oferta para este proyecto, revise el archivo adjunto. Yo proporcionaré la información básica de cada etiqueta (bodega, añada, D.O., variedad y datos analíticos si hicieran falta). A partir de ahí espero que transformes esos datos en textos que: • Despierten la curiosidad del cliente sin sonar a discurso de venta. • Describan aroma, sabor y sensaciones de forma vívida y comprensible. • Incluyan, cuando proceda, sugerencias de maridaje fáciles de visualizar. Entrego el listado de vinos en un documento compartido y recibiré de vuelta las notas revisadas en un archivo Word o Google Docs listo para maquetar. Una revisión está incluida para afinar matices de estilo o longitud si fuera necesario. Si dominas la redacción gastronómica y te entusiasma el vino tinto, será un proyecto sencillo y rápido de completar. Espero tu propuesta y ejemplos breves de trabajos similares.

opportunities.title: Hotel Housekeeping Automation
opportunities.description: I want to take the entire housekeeping workflow out of spreadsheets and paper and let it run itself inside (or alongside) our current hotel management software. We will begin with housekeeping before moving the same logic into the front office and purchasing departments, so whatever you build must be scalable and well-documented. For this first phase I need three things: • A scheduler that automatically creates daily room-cleaning rosters, assigns attendants based on occupancy and skill level, and updates in real-time when a guest checks out early or a VIP request comes in. • Digital cleaning checklists that attendants and supervisors tick off on a phone or tablet, complete with time-stamps and comments so I always know the exact room status. • Live supply- and linen-inventory tracking that deducts stock as items are issued, warns us when par levels are reached, and pushes a restock request straight to purchasing. Our property-management system is cloud-based and has an open API, so the solution can be a custom module, a third-party integration, or a lightweight standalone app that syncs back to the PMS—whichever you feel delivers the smoothest experience. When you reply, please tell me: • The stack or platform you would use and why it fits a hotel environment. • Any previous integrations you have completed with hotel PMS, housekeeping, or inventory systems. • A realistic timeline from kickoff to live deployment—including time for testing and staff training. Clean code, user-friendly interfaces, and clear hand-over documentation are non-negotiable, because once housekeeping is humming we will rinse and repeat in the other departments. If this sounds like the kind of project you enjoy, let’s talk.

opportunities.title: Multi-Format Bilingual Video Edits
opportunities.description: I need our finished German and English voice-over tracks turned into four polished videos that are ready to publish in two aspect ratios. From the same visual master you will create: • German 9:16 (vertical) • English 9:16 (vertical) • German 16:9 4 K (horizontal) • English 16:9 4 K (horizontal) The only difference between language versions should be the audio track and the subtitle layer; everything else—cuts, graphics, colour grade—remains identical. Each finished file must carry subtitles in both German and English so viewers can switch freely or, if you prefer, receive two discrete subtitle tracks alongside the render. I am supplying the final voice recordings for both languages. Please sync them accurately, place the subtitles cleanly with consistent styling, and export high-quality masters plus lightly-compressed social-media versions. A project file (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or DaVinci Resolve—whichever you work in) should be included so we can make future tweaks in-house. Deliverables are approved once all four videos play without sync issues, display crisp dual-language subtitles, and meet the exact aspect-ratio and 4 K specifications.

opportunities.title: AI Lead Outreach Agent
opportunities.description: I need a self-contained AI “super-agent” that automatically discovers fresh, relevant prospects and sends them a highly-personalized first-touch email on my behalf. Here’s the flow I want it to follow: every day the agent should search LinkedIn, public company-web databases, and any useful social media channels to compile a list of companies and decision-makers matching the ICP criteria I will provide. It must enrich each record with name, role, verified email, basic firmographics, and a short note on why the person is a good fit. Once the list is ready the same agent should draft and send a tailored email for every contact. I expect it to reference at least one data point unique to that prospect so it never looks templated. All sent messages, opens, and replies need to be logged to a simple dashboard or spreadsheet that I can review daily. I am open to whatever stack makes this reliable—Python, Node, LangChain, Zapier, Apollo, Clay, PhantomBuster or similar. Use native LinkedIn and email best-practices so profiles stay safe and deliverability remains high. Deliverable • A working script, bot, or SaaS-style workflow that runs on its own once given my seed criteria • Simple config file or UI where I can adjust ICP filters, email copy, send volume, and time windows • Documentation and a quick video walkthrough so I can redeploy or modify it easily Acceptance Criteria — Collects at least 50 new qualified leads in a 24-hour test window — Achieves 90 %+ valid email rate — Sends unique, context-aware emails with no spam flags — Logs every action to the agreed tracking sheet Once the agent hits those marks I will sign off and we can talk about follow-on phases such as meeting booking and multi-channel sequences.

opportunities.title: Event Set Design Renders Needed
opportunities.description: I’m planning an event that flows between an elegant indoor ballroom and its surrounding outdoor terrace. There are three different styling concepts on the table, each already sketched out with general layouts and mood references. What I need now is a full set of photorealistic, professionally lit renders—no AI filters or generators—so the production team, sponsors, and venue can visualise every detail before fabrication begins. Scope of each concept • 5 renders per concept (15 total) • Angles must collectively cover: – Main stage with guest seating sight-lines – Entrance and welcome/photo op area – Dining, lounge, and outdoor zones, showing how guests transition between them Assets you will receive – Hand-drawn plans with basic dimensions – Written style notes, colour palettes, and reference imagery I’m open to whichever software best achieves lifelike quality—3ds Max + V-Ray, Cinema 4D + Redshift, SketchUp + Enscape, or similar—as long as textures, lighting, and shadows read convincingly and files are delivered in high-resolution JPEG/PNG plus the native working files. Deliverables 1. Fifteen final 4K renders (5 per concept) 2. Source files organised by concept 3. Two revision rounds per render for camera angle, lighting, or minor décor tweaks Acceptance criteria • Surfaces, fabrics, and greenery must look realistic at full zoom • Accurate representation of the mixed indoor–outdoor footprint shown in my sketches • Consistent scale of people and furniture across all images Files and reference material will be shared immediately so you can begin blocking and texturing right away. I look forward to seeing the spaces come to life on screen.

opportunities.title: AI Influencer Live AMA Platform
opportunities.description: I run a virtual influencer built with generative-AI and I’m ready to take her interaction to the next level: real-time “Ask Me Anything” sessions streamed on Instagram or TikTok Live where viewers speak their questions through their microphones and receive spoken, perfectly lip-synced answers in her own voice. Here’s the flow I need working end-to-end: • Incoming audio from the live stream is captured and converted to accurate text fast enough to feel natural. • That text is fed into the character’s existing personality engine (GPT-style prompt chain already in place) to craft a short, on-brand reply. • The reply is turned back into speech with the exact voice model we use, then lip-synced to her face model and pushed straight back to the ongoing live video. • All of this must run continuously during a live broadcast on either Instagram or TikTok, keeping latency low so the audience feels they’re in a real conversation. Key points - You’ll be working with the current character assets (voice model, 3D face rig, style prompt library) and can choose the underlying stack—Unity, Unreal, OBS, WebRTC, or another pipeline—provided it meets the speed and quality targets. - The solution must survive typical live-stream chaos: overlapping voices, background noise, and large audience spikes. - A brief dashboard or CLI toggle to start/stop the pipeline, monitor latency, and log each question/response will help with show moderation. Deliverables 1. Running prototype demonstrating one full conversation loop on Instagram or TikTok Live. 2. Documented build/install instructions plus environment list. 3. Source code (Python/C#/C++ or mixed) with clear comments. 4. Post-launch support window to patch issues discovered in the first live event. Acceptance criteria • End-to-end round-trip (spoken question to spoken answer) consistently under 5 seconds. • Word error rate ≤ 8 % on noisy user audio. • Lip-sync visibly aligned within one video frame. • No streaming drops over a 30-minute test run. When you reply, focus on relevant experience with real-time GenAI character systems—links or brief case studies are perfect. Add your hourly rate and how long you expect the full build (through prototype) to take.

opportunities.title: AutoCAD Plan Area Quantification
opportunities.description: I have a steady stream of completed AutoCAD architectural plans and need precise quantity take-offs—not more design work. From each drawing I require total wall areas, individual door and window opening sizes, plus overall roof-slab areas. Your workflow should leave me with two clear deliverables for every plan: the original PDFs annotated with your dimensions and calculations, and an Excel sheet that neatly summarises the totals and any simple break-downs you needed to reach them. If you’ve already done similar measurement extractions from CAD or PDF (Bluebeam, AutoCAD, Revu, PlanSwift, etc.), let me know how many projects you’ve handled and the turn-around times you consistently hit; that practical experience is what I’ll weigh most heavily when choosing who to work with. Accuracy and organised output are everything here—get those right and there will be ongoing files coming your way.

opportunities.title: Sviluppo Piattaforma E-commerce Shopify Advanced – Brand Contemporary Art / Quiet Luxury
opportunities.description: Sviluppo Piattaforma E-commerce Shopify Advanced – Brand Contemporary Art / Quiet Luxury Descrizione del Progetto: KIROSY è un brand e incubatore d'arte contemporanea d'élite focalizzato sull'ecosistema culturale del Mediterraneo, rivolto a collezionisti internazionali e studi di architettura/interior design (B2B Contract). Cerchiamo un'agenzia o un freelance senior (Shopify Expert) per lo sviluppo e la configurazione dell'intera infrastruttura backend e front-end in modalità smaterializzata (Asset-Light / zero magazzino). Il progetto non richiede la scrittura di codice custom da zero, ma la configurazione e l'integrazione avanzata di plug-in professionali ed ecosistemi API già esistenti sul mercato. Specifiche Tecniche richieste: 1. Front-End & UX: Personalizzazione sartoriale di un tema premium orientato al mercato del lusso (es. Dawn strutturato o simili). Creazione di schede prodotto complesse per Opere Originali, Edizioni POD di Lusso e Capsule Collection. Sviluppo di una Landing Page B2B con modulo di profilazione e area riservata protetta per il download di file 3D (Render-Ready). 2. Backend Finanziario: Configurazione delle regole di checkout e split automatico delle commissioni (payout differenziati tra B2C e B2B). Configurazione degli oneri dei gateway di pagamento (Shopify Payments con tariffe transfrontaliere ponderate al 2,05%). 3. Logistica e Dogane (DDP): Integrazione nativa tramite API con i laboratori partner (Contrado Londra e The Print Space). Implementazione e calcolo volumetrico/valore in tempo reale al checkout a carico del cliente per spedizioni XXL e Assicurazioni All-Risks (tramite ShippyPro, Sendcloud o Packlink Pro). Configurazione dazi DDP automatizzati per mercati extra-UE (UK/Svizzera). 4. Compliance Doganale & Ministeriale: Vincolo in backend per inserimento obbligatorio HS Code 9701 (opere eseguite a mano) e sistema di blocco/spunta cautelativo dei payout per l'esportazione di artisti italiani (integrazione documentale SUE/Belle Arti). 5. Web-App "One-Click": Sviluppo o configurazione di un'interfaccia mobile semplificata (PWA o automazione di inventario Shopify via API) per permettere agli artisti della scuderia di congelare/rimuovere istantaneamente un'opera dal catalogo in caso di vendita privata. 6. Infrastruttura Web3 & Filantropia: Integrazione nativa con app di certificazione d'arte (es. Verisart o Trovee) per la generazione post-acquisto di un Passaporto Digitale in Blockchain (Polygon/Solana) e collegamento logico a tag hardware NFC fisici. Automazione del trigger finanziario per l'accantonamento del 3% di ogni vendita da devolvere a fondazioni no-profit (MEDSEA, FAI, MEDASSET). 7. Tracciamento: Configurazione avanzata delle Conversion API di Meta (Pixel) per ottimizzazione funnel e setup di Google Analytics (GA4). Modelli di Collaborazione e Budget: Siamo flessibili sulla struttura del deal e aperti a valutare due diverse modalità di accordo, in base al profilo del candidato: • Opzione Cash: erogato a tappe (milestones) basate sullo stato di avanzamento dei lavori. • Opzione Vesting (Work for Equity): Per profili senior o agenzie partner disposte a sposare la visione a lungo termine del brand, siamo aperti a strutturare un patto di Vesting legalmente vincolato. L'accordo prevederà il rilascio progressivo di una quota societaria di minoranza al tassativo raggiungimento di obiettivi operativi, tecnici e di performance marketing concordati per il primo anno (es. completamento tech e stabilità del ROAS a target). Tempistiche: Messa online della piattaforma entro 45-60 giorni dall'assegnazione dell'incarico. Per candidarsi, inviare portfolio di e-commerce realizzati su Shopify (preferibilmente nel settore lusso/arte), specificando per quale modalità di collaborazione (Cash o Vesting) ci si sta candidando e una brevissima nota su come si intende strutturare l'integrazione Web3/NFC e l'app di congelamento inventario.

opportunities.title: AutoCAD Expert
opportunities.description: I have a series of mechanical and electrical designs that now need to be translated into clean, production-ready AutoCAD drawings. Because these projects tie directly into local coordination and time-sensitive communication, I would like to work exclusively with a drafter based in India. Here’s what I need from you: • Detailed, well-layered .dwg files that conform to standard mechanical/electrical drafting conventions • Companion PDFs suitable for quick review and mark-up • Drawings delivered in the version of AutoCAD you normally use, with any xrefs or custom fonts packaged and ready to open on my end You will receive all reference material the moment we start—dimensions, sketches, and any existing CAD backgrounds—to keep the process smooth. Accuracy, tidy line-weights, and clear annotation are important, so please factor adequate checking time into your workflow. If you regularly create mechanical or electrical drawings and can commit to responsive collaboration during Indian working hours, I’d like to hear how soon you can take the first file and your typical turnaround per sheet.

opportunities.title: Photo-Based AI Interior Visuals
opportunities.description: I regularly receive nothing more than site photos from clients, so I need a designer who can start from those raw images—no floor plans—yet still show me exactly how the finished spaces could look. From the construction shots I supply, you will: • Generate four to five AI-driven concept images for every requested room: living & dining, bedrooms, and kitchen & bathrooms. The dominant mood should read “warm and luxurious,” though small variations are welcome so I can compare nuances. You are free to use your preferred tools—Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, DALL·E, Photoshop, Blender, Lumion, Twinmotion, or similar—so long as the output is photorealistic and matches the camera angles of my photos. I will supply high-resolution, well-lit reference shots and a brief for finishes and furniture once we start. This will be a regular work and we've got atleast 4 to 5 project in average a month running so it's regular work. Because every project is time-sensitive, I expect punctuality in project delivery. I’m looking for an immediate kickoff and quick iterations. Please reply with a short note on your workflow for turning site photos into AI concepts, examples of comparable work, and the approximate turnaround you can guarantee for the first batch of concepts.

opportunities.title: Luxury 3500 sq ft Office Design
opportunities.description: I need a complete interior-design consultancy package for a 3,500 sq. ft luxury modern corporate office that will seat more than 50 people. The scope is strictly design—no turnkey execution—so I expect comprehensive drawings, specifications and visualisations I can hand over to local contractors. The workplace mix includes reception, executive cabins, premium meeting rooms, open workstations and a well-appointed cafeteria/pantry. I’m looking for a refined, contemporary aesthetic that balances high-end finishes with practical space planning and efficient MEP coordination. Please base your fixed-price proposal on delivering: • Full space planning with detailed 2D layout • Concept mood boards and material palettes for a luxury modern look • Photorealistic 3D renders and a short 3D walkthrough • Ceiling, lighting and electrical layouts in AutoCAD • Furniture, carpentry and built-in joinery drawings ready for fabrication • Material and finish specifications, plus a detailed BOQ • Clean, well-layered working drawings in DWG/PDF formats I’d like to review comparable office projects you’ve handled in the 3,000–5,000 sq. ft range, along with sample technical sheets or drawing sets. Independent designers and studios across India are welcome; prior corporate work and client references will help me make a quick decision. Kindly confirm you can supply all deliverables, outline your design process, and indicate how you will keep the total fee within my stated range.

opportunities.title: Diseño de etiquetas elegantes
opportunities.description: Busco un ilustrador con buen dominio de tipografía y composición para crear la línea completa de etiquetas para perfumes similares a las que aparecen en el estilo mostrado en Stickerr.com. El estilo debe ser claramente elegante y minimalista, sin ornamentos innecesarios, para resaltar la calidad premium de la marca. Alcance • Diseñar un layout maestro coherente con nuestra identidad visual. • Adaptar ese layout a más de cinco fragancias diferentes, manteniendo unidad gráfica pero con pequeñas variaciones de color o motivo que faciliten la distinción de cada aroma. • Incluir únicamente el nombre del perfume y el logotipo en cada versión; otros datos (ingredientes, código de barras) irán en el estuche, por lo que no se incorporan en esta fase. Entregables 1. Archivo vectorial editable (AI o SVG) del diseño maestro. 2. Versiones finales para cada fragancia en PDF listo para imprenta y PNG de alta resolución para redes. 3. Hoja de especificaciones de color y tipografía. Criterios de aceptación – Estética minimalista y coherente en toda la serie. – Legibilidad perfecta del nombre y del logo a escala de 50 mm. – Uso de colores Pantone o CMYK especificados. Aprecio portafolios que muestren trabajos similares al diseño minimalista y sofisticado expuesto en Stickerr.com.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40793878, publicado hace 16 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 30 - 250.

opportunities.title: Cold Call Software Sales Closer
opportunities.description: Voy a necesitar que realices llamadas en frío tanto a empresas privadas como a unidades educativas; doy la misma prioridad a ambos segmentos. El objetivo es presentarles nuestro software, centrado en digitalizar procesos y reducir el trabajo manual dentro de sus operaciones diarias. Durante cada llamada espero que cierres la venta en ese mismo contacto, por lo que es indispensable un enfoque de “one-call close” y experiencia probada en cierres B2B por teléfono. Somos una empresa relativamente nueva pero que ya ha trabajado con algunas de estas empresas que te pido que cierres contacto, la lista de prospectos te las daré yo, ten en cuenta que son llamadas en frío; tú ajustarás el pitch según las objeciones que surjan, manteniendo siempre el foco en la productividad que aporta la solución. Entregables concretos: • Ventas cerradas con datos completos del cliente. • Resumen diario de llamadas efectuadas y resultado de cada una. El proyecto arranca de inmediato; si las primeras semanas muestran un buen ratio de cierres, podremos ampliar la base de leads y convertir esto en colaboración continua. Hablemos de tu experiencia cerrando en frío y tu disponibilidad para comenzar. Trabajaremos mediante comisiones de entre un 10 a 20% por cada venta cerrada según la complejidad de cada software. Necesito que hables español e inglés de manera fluida. Haz las preguntas que necesites, si crees que puedes con el trabajo pregunta, solo interesados a trabajar de manera proactiva y responsable.

opportunities.title: Mantenimiento Data Lake Azure + Pipelines Etl en Databricks
opportunities.description: Tenemos un DataLake montado en Azure con tres capas de explotación de datos Oro/Plata/Bronce. Dentro de la infraestructura tenemos una serie de Pipelines (ETL's) complejos que nos permiten generar una serie de informes. Buscamos un perfil que sea capaz de resolvernos varias incidencias que se han acumulado desde que montamos el DL con una empresa externa, que nos pueda hacer mantenimiento de la infraestructura, así como modificar los flujos y pipelines montados para afinar los informes diseñados. El perfil tendrá como funciones: - Diseñar y mantener pipelines de datos. - Optimizar el rendimiento de bases de datos analíticas. - Diseñar modelos de datos y estructuras de Data Lake. - Garantizar la calidad y trazabilidad de la información. - Dar soporte en analítica y reporting (en la transformaciones de las capas Gold/Silver). - Colaborar en la definición de KPIs y explotación de datos para negocio. Como requisitos ha de tener conocimientos de: - Diseño y desarrollo de procesos etl/elt. - SQL avanzado. - PostgreSQL y optimización de consultas, índices, particiones y almacenamiento. - Modelado de datos para entornos analíticos. - Data Lakes con arquitecturas Bronze / Silver / Gold. - Orquestación de procesos con Airflow o herramientas similares. - Python para procesamiento y transformación de datos. - Experiencia con Azure y Databricks. El perfil tiene que poder reunirse en horario de España, aunque trabaje de forma asíncrona mayormente. Imprescindible un perfil de habla hispana. Categoría: Programación y Tecnología Subcategoría: Data Science ¿Es un proyecto o una posición?: Un proyecto Disponibilidad requerida: A tiempo parcial

Como requisitos ha de tener conocimientos de: - Diseño y desarrollo de procesos etl/elt. - SQL avanzado. - PostgreSQL y optimización de consultas, índices, particiones y almacenamiento. - Modelado de datos para entornos analíticos. - Data Lakes con arquitecturas Bronze / Silver / Gold. - Orquestación de procesos con Airflow o herramientas similares. - Python para procesamiento y transformación de datos. - Experiencia con Azure y Databricks. El perfil tiene que poder reunirse en horario de España, aunque trabaje de forma asíncrona mayormente. Imprescindible un perfil de habla hispana.
